description: Rothco’s Tactical Concealed Carry Waist Pack is a lightweight and discreet carry solution for your storage needs. With 5 multi-functional pockets, including a hidden back zippered compartment with a loop field for secure ERC storage, this CCW waist pack offers versatility and convenience. The top zippered compartment features a loop field on top and a 10 inch x 4.5 inch internal pocket, ideal for everyday carry items. Additionally, the tactical pack includes 3 multi-functional outer pouches, with 2 outer triangular pouches measuring 4.5 inch x 5 inch x 5 inch x 1 inch and a center pouch measuring 4.25 inch x 5.25 inch x 1 inch. The center pouch features a quick-release buckle flap closure and loop field for added security. Constructed of durable denier polyester, this pack is built to withstand daily use. The adjustable 51 inch x 1.5 inch waist strap with quick-release buckle ensures a comfortable and secure fit. With a total width of 4 inches, this tactical hip pack offers discreet and versatile storage options for everyday carry essentials.
